page.title: Privacy information
page.description: How this website handles personal data used for orders, accounts and essential operation.

incomplete: Development notice: required controller, processor and retention information is not yet complete. This version cannot be published in production.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The organisation identified below determines why and how the personal data described on this page is handled.

data.title: Data handled by the application
data.intro: The application handles only data needed for its implemented features.
data.orders: Guest orders: name, phone, email, city, delivery address, optional note, locale, selected products, quantities, payment method, prices, promotions, VAT, totals, order status and audited changes.
data.accounts: Accounts and authentication: name, email, verification state, password hash or configured social-provider identifiers and credentials, sessions, verification/reset records, IP address and user agent where recorded by the authentication system.
data.technical: Essential browser state: theme preference, cart product IDs and quantities, temporary checkout draft, idempotency state and short-lived signed confirmation state.

purposes.title: Why the data is used
purposes.orders: To receive, validate, review, confirm, administer and preserve an accurate history of orders.
purposes.accounts: To create and secure accounts, sign users in, verify email addresses and support password recovery.
purposes.security: To maintain application security, prevent duplicate submissions and diagnose operational failures. The application does not use this data for marketing profiling or solely automated order decisions.

legalBasis.title: Legal bases
legalBasis.body: The applicable legal basis must be stated accurately for each purpose before publication.

sharing.title: Recipients, processors and transfers
sharing.body: Access is limited to authorised administrators and service providers needed to operate the application. Provider and transfer details must match the production deployment.
sharing.transfers: Transfers outside the EEA and safeguards

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Retention must be defined for each purpose. An order is not deleted merely because it is rejected, cancelled or completed, but this does not by itself define its final personal-data retention period.

rights.title: Your data-protection rights
rights.body: Subject to the applicable conditions, you may contact the controller to exercise your rights.
rights.access: Request information about and access to your personal data.
rights.rectification: Ask for inaccurate or incomplete data to be corrected.
rights.erasure: Ask for erasure where the applicable conditions are met.
rights.restriction: Ask for processing to be restricted in applicable cases.
rights.portability: Request portable data where the right applies.
rights.objection: Object to processing where the right applies.

complaint.title: Questions and complaints
complaint.body: Contact the controller first if you have a privacy question or wish to exercise a right. You may also complain to the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection:

storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
storage.body: The current application uses essential session/authentication state, a theme preference, a local cart, a temporary checkout draft and a short-lived order-confirmation cookie. It does not currently use advertising or analytics storage.
